regime_context: Hong Kong is in a tight one-narrative regime: Banks (H + HK) hold a 0.203 margin over Energy (H-shares) and are the only theme with both eligibility (absolute-trend gate) and a durable leadership bar (0.54, mean-revert tagged). Only 2 of 17 themes pass the trend gate, so the tradable universe is extremely narrow and most ranks are a focus lens with no return edge. Everything below rank 2 is ineligible; China Tech/Internet and Platform Megacaps are the only scorable proxies and they are deeply negative.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) moves from eligible=false to eligible=true with its trend hurst_tag intact — that single gate flip would retire the watch and confirm a handoff beyond the current one-narrative Banks regime.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole eligible leader with the strongest durability bar (0.54) and one_narrative dominance. The detector's validated leg is the absolute-trend gate (drawdown/shake-out control), and Banks are the only theme that qualifies against it; the gate_helps flag is true for this market, so staying with the one gated leader is the disciplined read. Crowding is absent (z=0.6, not crowded), so no size-down caution applies. The lean is a directional preference to remain exposed rather than predict continued outperformance, given rank-IC ~0.
evidence: eligible=true (only theme with a passing absolute-trend gate)
theses.dissent: hurst_tag is mean-revert, so the theme's own momentum regime is not trending and could snap back; breadth (0.385) is moderate and the Hang Seng benchmark itself may chop sideways rather than allow a single sector to carry.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) falls below its 20-day moving average of relative strength to the Hang Seng before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the challenger and shows trend character (hurst_tag=trend) but fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false). With gate_helps=true, the one validated discipline says to stand down from themes that do not clear the gate. The rotation margin (0.203) is not confirmed as a handoff, and rotation timing has no forward edge, so no switch call is warranted.
theses.dissent: Energy has a trend hurst_tag and near-tied momentum; if it clears the gate next, it would become the new eligible leader and the avoid would reverse.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) becomes eligible=true with a durability_bar exceeding 0.5 before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech is the weakest of the scorable themes (score -0.797, rank 13) and fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false). The macro backdrop is dominated by ai_tech headlines (n=10 of 29), but that is coincident market-level flow, not a trigger; the only validated discipline says stay out of non-gated, deeply negative-momentum themes. No crowding flag exists to fade, and fading is forbidden anyway.
theses.dissent: If ai_tech macro narrative flow spills into a genuine HK tech re-rating and 3033.HK crosses above the Hang Seng on rising breadth, the avoid would be too cautious.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK gains more than 8% relative to the Hang Seng and clears its absolute-trend gate before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
